Name: Lehnsa's Content Packs for Teh's Fishing Overhaul
Author: Sanithus
Description:
I've made two content packs for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/866]Teh's Fishing Overhaul[/url].

The first pack, ArtifactRemoval, does three things:
[list]
[*]Adds bone artifacts to the treasure pool that are usually found through other means (Prehistoric Tibia, Skeletal hand, Prehistoric Rib, etc)
[*]Removes all artifacts from the treasure pool once the museum has been completed
[*]Adds the Artifact Trove into the pool once the museum has been completed.
[/list]
This makes completing the museum easier, as well as making treasure hunting more lucrative post museum with potential access to Pearls and Golden Pumpkins.

The second pack, TreasureEdits, is a collection of changes that I personally enjoy:
[list]
[*]Replaces regular bait with wild bait in treasure chests
[*]Makes it possible to get almost any tackle in treasure chests after fishing lvl 9 (regular spinner and quality bobber excluded)
[*]Adds Cinder Shards and Dragon Teeth to the treasure pool, but only in certain areas (Shards anywhere on Ginger Island and Dragon Teeth only at the caldera of the volcano)
[*]Removes shoes and weapons from the treasure pool
[*]Removes the gem rings from the treasure pool (only ones that can regularly be bought from the Adventurer's Guild. Magnet rings, glow rings and iridium bands are still in the pool)
[/list]
This expands the usefulness of treasure chests for a seasoned fisher in mid to late game.

Simply drag and drop the file into Stardew Valley/Mods in order to install.


ToDo: Make wild bait in TreasureEdits conditional on whether player has wild bait crafting recipe


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/866]Teh's Fishing Overhaul[/url] is a requirement, as well as everything TFO requires.


These packs were possible thanks to the help of Tehpers as well as their documents on [url=https://github.com/TehPers/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/docs/TehPers.FishingOverhaul/Content%20Packs.md]how to make content packs[/url].
